correctness.rationale: The published manifold and 1-connectivity theorems supply a closed simply connected orientable 4-manifold with torsion-free homology. Exhaustive cell enumeration yields face counts (42,210,490,420,140), Euler characteristic 42 and b2=40. The explicit 140-facet signed fundamental cycle has zero integral boundary and a vertex transposition reverses its orientation, forcing signature zero. An exact 209-vector kernel basis exhausts all mod-two degree-two cocycles, every cup square vanishes with the Alexander–Whitney product diagonal, and the induced pairing on 40 cohomology classes is alternating and nondegenerate. Thus the integral unimodular form is even, signature zero, rank 40, hence 20 hyperbolic planes; Freedman identifies the topological homeomorphism type. Checker source and output are embedded. No unproved extension or smooth equivalence is claimed.
